entries.title: types/factoria.d.ts is a placeholder stub
entries.missing: Project types/factoria.d.ts generated by 'factoria new' is a 12-line placeholder typing everything as any, although AGENTS.md says it holds the script API typings. Typos in API names are not caught and signatures (e.g. raycast3d arg types) cannot be looked up in the project.
entries.workaround: Ran 'factoria api --dts' and grep'ed it for signatures instead (did not overwrite the generated file).
entries.suggestion: Have 'factoria new' write the real output of 'factoria api --dts' (or make the stub header say clearly to run it), and keep it refreshed on validate.

entries.title: AI guide marks working CLI commands as planned
entries.missing: ai-guide says 'factoria validate/test/call/commands/docs read' and '--input' replay are (planned) and 'the CLI is still being built', but they all work. Misleads agents into avoiding the CLI.
entries.workaround: Tried each command anyway; all worked.

entries.title: Kinematic 3D platforms do not carry bodies standing on them
entries.missing: A RigidBody3D kinematic platform moved by velocity slides out from under a dynamic ball resting on it; the ball does not inherit platform velocity even with friction. Moving platforms are a staple of 3D arcade games.
entries.workaround: scripts/ball.js raycasts down, reads the ground entity's RigidBody3D.velocity and adds it to the ball velocity (rider-velocity emulation).
entries.suggestion: Carry dynamic bodies resting on kinematic bodies (apply platform velocity to supported bodies), or expose the contact's other body + a 'standingOn' query on RigidBody3D.

entries.title: Bug: physics.raycast3d ignores array vectors and hits the caster's own collider
entries.missing: raycast3d([x,y,z],[0,-1,0],1) silently returns null although Vec3Like in the typings suggests arrays are valid (only vec3() objects work). Also a ray starting inside the ball's own collider returns the ball itself at distance 0, and there is no 'ignore entity' option, so a ground check from the ball center needs layers+mask tricks.
entries.workaround: Put ball on collider layer 1 and cast with vec3() args and {mask:1} (layer 0 only) from the ball center.
entries.suggestion: Accept arrays for Vec3Like (or throw a clear error), add opts.ignore (entity or id) and skip colliders containing the origin by default; add RigidBody3D/entity.isGrounded() for 3D like the 2D one.

entries.title: 3D bodies have no rotation dynamics so a 'rolling' ball cannot roll
entries.missing: RigidBody3D/Collider3D ignore rotation (documented), so a ball does not roll or get angular velocity; friction does not turn horizontal motion into spin and there is no angularVelocity field like RigidBody2D.
entries.workaround: scripts/ball.js integrates Transform.rotation from horizontal velocity (v/r) purely visually and drives velocity directly with acceleration.
entries.suggestion: Add angular velocity / rolling for sphere colliders, or at least RigidBody3D.angularVelocity + a rolling-friction option.

entries.title: Shape2D has no pivot and screen-space anchoring is under-documented
entries.missing: Screen-space Shape2D rectangles are centered on Transform.position (no pivot field), unlike Text/Sprite which have pivot; docs only say origin is top-left. My first HUD panels were half off-screen. Text pivot [0,1]='top-left' and [1,0]='bottom-right' also confused me (y-down).
entries.workaround: Manually offset panel positions by half the size (scenes/main.scene.json hud_panel_l / hud_panel_r).
entries.suggestion: Add pivot to Shape2D, document that rectangles are centered, and add anchors (top-right etc.) for screen-space UI so layouts survive resolution/scaleMode changes.

entries.title: Headless runs and tests render every frame in software (about 40 ms/frame)
entries.missing: factoria test and run --headless render every simulated frame on llvmpipe: 270 frames took 11-14 s. A 90 s game timer (5400 frames) would take ~4 min in a test; there is no flag to skip rendering/shadows in tests or to step many frames fast.
entries.workaround: Tests poke script state (timeLeft) and use short step counts; scenes kept small.
entries.suggestion: Add 'factoria test'/'run --no-render' (logic only) and render only on screenshot frames; make game.step(n) skip rendering except the last frame.

entries.title: ParticleEmitter burst does nothing when emitting is false
entries.missing: Docs say burst is 'emitted once when the emitter starts' but a one-shot effect with emitting:false, burst:40 shows no particles; it only bursts when emitting is true. For a one-shot gem sparkle I expected emitting:false + burst to work; nothing logged either.
entries.workaround: scripts/gem.js spawns an emitter with emitting:true, rate:0, burst:40 and destroys it after 1.5 s via a game.js timer.
entries.suggestion: Make burst fire regardless of emitting, add an emitter 'oneShot/autoDestroy' option (destroy entity when done) and a script-callable emitter.burst(n).

entries.title: Deferred destroy makes entity ids of just-destroyed entities unusable
entries.missing: world.spawn with an explicit id right after destroy() of an entity with the same id (e.g. a tool that clears and re-places gems in one frame) warns 'id already used; renamed to gem_2_2', so ids are not stable/predictable.
entries.workaround: tools/scatter_gems.js picks a free id (suffix _rN) when world.find(id) still returns the doomed entity.
entries.suggestion: Free the id immediately on destroy(), or offer entity.destroyNow()/world.flush() for tools and tests.

entries.title: No 3D gameplay recipes in the AI guide
entries.missing: Recipes (platformer, top-down, camera follow, collisions) are all 2D. For a 3D rolling-ball game I had to discover by experiment: camera yaw convention (forward=(-sin,-cos)), that 3D triggers need a RigidBody3D static to fire, a 3D ground check, how kinematic 3D bodies behave, and a 3D chase camera with onLateUpdate.
entries.workaround: Experimented with probe tests (tests/gem_roller.test.js covers the results).
entries.suggestion: Add 3D recipes: chase camera, camera-relative movement, ground check, trigger pickups, moving platforms, and a note on which components a 3D trigger needs.

entries.title: Tests cannot fast-forward without rendering or inspect script state conveniently
entries.missing: game.find(id).behaviour exposes script fields, but there is no documented way to read it (found by trial); and game.step cannot be told to skip shadows/rendering for long simulations.
entries.workaround: Tests mutate behaviour fields (timeLeft, yaw) directly and teleport the ball to gems.
entries.suggestion: Document entity.behaviour in the testing section and add game.step(n,{render:false}).
